notes.title: Second Small Update
notes.content:
*Upgrade items and particles were blurry when moving fast. That is no longer the case.

*I removed a bug with the inventory, which caused a minor performance hit.

notes.title: Oct 15 Patch Notes
notes.content:
* Some missions have custom round layouts you get each time, while others give you a random one each time. I added additional random layouts.

* I removed the passageway music glitch. If you walked back-and-forth at the beginning of those segments, multiple tracks played.

* I added a new enemy to the game. It can be found primarily at the Plumbing Outskirts, but is also in a few other missions.
